source: TAES v1.0 suggested default pillar weights mapped to the six LaunchIndex sections (Product 16% + Technology 14% -> Problem & Solution; Founder 18%; Market 14%; Business Model 12%; Financial 10%; IP 8% -> Innovation & Impact). The cross-cutting Risk pillar (8%) is redistributed proportionally across the six sections. TAES describes these as configurable suggested defaults, not a fixed institutional policy.
approved_by: TIDES project owner (decision recorded in the engineering session)
missing_policy_note: LaunchIndex: missing mandatory (starred) information lowers the score, so a required criterion with no applicant information scores 0. Optional and conditional criteria (e.g. FI-08 external funding, PS-10 demo link) and not-applicable items are excluded, not penalised. Explicit zero or 'No' answers are preserved as answers.
decision_note: No score cut-offs: TAES defines no thresholds and requires the final decision to come from the supervisory synthesis. The committee decides using the weighted score and the supervisory recommendation.

red_flag_rules.action: Flag for TRL investigation by the committee (not an automatic rejection)
Flag potential dilution / governance concern (not an automatic rejection)
